materialization_rules.discovery_id: Use the exact event-level discovery_id corresponding to each W34-Cxxx in the repaired event-discovery-v2.jsonl; W34-C001 maps to w34-event-c001 through W34-C105 maps to w34-event-c105.

reason.KEEP: <title> is materially relevant to W34 on current relevance and/or technical significance; proceed to Evidence verification without treating discovery claims as established evidence.
reason.MAYBE: <title> has a plausible W34 delta, but its relative technical/editorial significance is not yet strong enough for unconditional Evidence priority.
reason.INSPECT: <title> may be materially relevant, but source identity, chronology, authority, or claim scope remains insufficiently resolved for a direct KEEP/DROP decision.
reason.DROP: <title> is outside the ordinary W34 scope, duplicate/context-only, routine noise, or lacks sufficient standalone technical relevance for Evidence work.

materialization_rules.scope_tags: Deterministically derive from source.metadata.lane by splitting on ' / ', trimming, lowercasing, replacing spaces with hyphens, and removing duplicates. Do not introduce new semantic tags beyond the lane components.
materialization_rules.verification_targets: For KEEP, MAYBE, and INSPECT use exactly one target: source.metadata.next_verification when non-empty, otherwise source.summary_text. For DROP use an empty array.

sol_screening_rationale.KEEP: Clear W34 technical/product/research/infrastructure delta with sufficient importance to justify Evidence verification.
sol_screening_rationale.MAYBE: Real or plausible W34 delta, but relative importance versus stronger items is not yet clear.
sol_screening_rationale.INSPECT: Potentially material item blocked by first-party authority, exact chronology, artifact identity, or concrete claim-scope uncertainty.
sol_screening_rationale.DROP: Pure pre/post-window background, explicit duplicate/context cluster, routine nightly/noise, or insufficient standalone technical relevance.

guards: Exactly 105 event decisions are authoritative; no event may be omitted or added.
Luna must not change a Sol decision or reinterpret a DROP/KEEP/MAYBE/INSPECT assignment.
Materialization fields may be generated only by the deterministic rules in this file from the repaired event-discovery input.
DailyX/Grok/X observations remain discovery/community signals and are not technical Evidence.
Formal Screening acceptance and lifecycle advancement are allowed only after all three Core result files validate against the exact prepared package basis.
No Evidence acceptance, Materiality, Completeness, Selection, Architecture, or Human Gate work is authorized by this decision record.
